findings.label: Missing architecture.test.ts
findings.detail: The task references architecture.test.ts as something that should still apply, but no such file exists in the repo. Not a regression since there is nothing to break; structure is enforced by convention and was verified by the prior design review. Worth confirming this is intentional.

findings.label: Import ordering in mobile domain/profile.ts
findings.detail: apps/mobile/src/features/profile/domain/profile.ts has a duplicate `import type { Profile }` and an import placed after an export. Valid TypeScript and typecheck passes; tidy for readability only.

findings.label: Deploy-time preconditions (out of gate scope)
findings.detail: Supabase Realtime publication acceptance and a valid base64 32-byte CLAVE_INICIAL_KEY are not exercised by the local gate. Both are mitigated in-code (polling fallback for Task 1; fail-closed AES-GCM for Task 2) and documented in README. Verify during deploy.
